messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert — high error rate observed for runtime-v2 inference path. Paging oncall: oncall-alex

oncall-alex: ack I'm on it. Pulling metrics and recent deploys now.

deploy-bot: deploy completed to runtime-v2 at 2234567000 by eng-priya — image: rwinf/runtime:v1.26

sre-riley: I'm seeing a spike in 5xx starting ~2234567200. Traces show a cache read returning malformed object causing fallback to KV-bypass, which increases latency and amplifies errors. Top affected tenants: tenant-42, tenant-ops, tenant-analytics. QPS +40% on those shards.

eng-priya: I'm ready to roll quick mitigations. Plan: disable prefix caching for affected tenants, apply per-tenant QPS caps, and route non-critical requests to a smaller quantized model variant. Will use redwoodctl toggles.

oncall-alex: agreed. Live mitigation checklist:
- disable prefix cache for tenant-42 and tenant-ops
- set tenant-analytics qps cap to 30rps for 30m
- enable fallback routing to quantized-small for non-critical traffic
- notify CS and PM

sre-riley: commands I'm going to run and will paste exact output:

```
# disable prefix cache for specific tenant
redwoodctl feature-toggle set runtime-v2 prefix-cache --tenant tenant-42 --state off --reason "correctness fallback"
redwoodctl feature-toggle set runtime-v2 prefix-cache --tenant tenant-ops  --state off --reason "correctness fallback"

# temp QPS cap
redwoodctl quota set tenant-analytics qps 30 --duration 30m --reason "mitigation"
```

pm-jasmin: I'll draft a short customer-facing blurb once we confirm initial mitigation results. cs-sam can you start outreach to the top affected customers?

cs-sam: Reached out to tenant-42 and tenant-ops. Tenant-42 reports intermittent 5xx and slow responses; using fallback path, latency currently ~800ms. No data loss reported. I'll wait for confirmation before posting to status.

eng-priya: applied the feature toggles in canary, then propagated. Immediate effect: tenant-42 error rate dropped from 18% -> 1.7% within 2 minutes. Tenant-analytics still showing elevated tail latency.

oncall-alex: good. Next step: gradually rollback the QPS cap for tenant-analytics over 15m if errors remain <2%. Also keep prefix-cache disabled for tenant-ops for 30m while we validate.

sre-riley: found a likely root cause — an index key mismatch in the prefetch/indexer after the latest config change. Opening bug RW-CR-2234 for the indexer and prefetch validation. Logs attached in the internal tracker.

deploy-bot: rollback of indexer config commit c3f9d applied at 2234567905 to staging and prod indexing job.

eng-priya: after the rollback the prefix hit ratio recovered to ~92% for most shards. We'll keep tenant-ops toggled off for another 30m and monitor.

oncall-alex: customer impact summary for status and handoff:
- tenant-42: intermittent 5xx, mitigated; no data loss.
- tenant-ops: proactively disabled prefix caching to avoid correctness issues; degraded latency expected; CS informed.
- tenant-analytics: temporarily throttled; batch jobs delayed but will recover after rollbacks.

pm-jasmin: status page draft: "We detected a cache index mismatch causing requests to bypass the KV/prefix cache, leading to increased errors and latency. We applied targeted cache toggles and per-tenant rate limits; the issue is mitigated and under monitoring. A postmortem will follow."

cs-sam: customer messages queued, will send post-mitigation update shortly.

oncall-alex: handing off to sre-riley for the monitoring window and postmortem. I need to step off in 20m.

sre-riley: taking ownership. I'll validate logs, coordinate the bugfix PR, and schedule a canary test for prefetch index validation. PR and repro: https://redwood.internal/rw/CR-2234

incident-bot: Incident P1 status changed to "mitigated -> monitoring". Tags: cache-index-mismatch, targeted-rate-limits, prefix-toggle.

oncall-alex: thanks everyone, keep updates concise in this thread. I'll follow up with the oncall notes.
